look_here_first: Inspect opposite clasping leaves, four-angled stem and small axillary flower clusters. Check the floral tube, calyx appendages and capsule against A. auriculata; color alone is insufficient.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Erect annual wetland herb, often reddish four-angled stems.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Opposite, sessile, narrow, clasping or auriculate bases.

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Small axillary flowers with persistent floral tube and calyx appendages.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Many-seeded capsule surrounded by persistent floral tube.
